user.title: Mission Control
user.description: A project board in the sidebar, backed by its own database (/config/mission_control.db). It starts with five branches — Home, Projects, Personal, Work and Automotive — which you can change later under Configure. Every field here is optional.

data.ai_task_entity: AI Task entity for quick add

data_description.person_name: Accepted as OWNER: <name> on a card and used in the pushes. Leave empty to be "you".
data_description.ai_task_entity: Files quick notes for you: picks the branch, lane, effort and next step, and splits mixed notes. Without one, a note becomes a plain card.
data_description.calendar_entity: Every open card with a due date gets an all-day event here. Events you make by hand are never touched.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Mission Control is already set up.

data.ai_task_entity: AI Task entity for quick add

data_description.packages: Adds sensor.packages_* and the order services. Nothing feeds it on its own: an automation calls mission_control.order_upsert (see the README). A card can then wait with BLOCKED BY: order <number>.
data_description.shopping: Adds todo.mission_shopping, sensor.mission_shopping and the shopping services. It sits next to Home Assistant's own Shopping list.

add_branch.title: Add a branch
add_branch.description: A branch is one tracker: one to-do list (todo.<key>_tracker) and one page in the panel. The key is made from the name and never changes.

data.name: Name
data.assistant: The assistant can usually do this work

data_description.work: Untagged cards here count as work, and weekday work hours bring them forward.
data_description.assistant: Cards here default to the assistant's move instead of yours (desk work an AI can finish alone).
data_description.keywords: Comma-separated words that make the quick-add box suggest this branch.

edit_branch_details.title: Edit a branch
edit_branch_details.description: Key: {key} (its to-do list is todo.{key}_tracker and does not change).

data.name: Name
data.assistant: The assistant can usually do this work

remove_branch.title: Remove a branch
remove_branch.description: Only a branch with no cards (open or closed) can be removed. Move or delete its cards first.

error.name_taken: Another branch already has that name.

file_note.name: File a note
file_note.description: Turn a plain-language note into a card (or a few). With an AI Task entity set in the options, the model files it; otherwise it becomes one plain card.

source.name: Source
source.description: Where it came from: panel, voice, phone. Anything but panel adds a detected duplicate as a note on the existing card instead of asking.

pins.name: Pinned fields
pins.description: Overrides for the main card, e.g. {"branch": "home", "due": "2026-12-01"}.

force.name: File even if it looks like a duplicate

digest.name: Build a digest
digest.description: Build the morning plan or the evening wrap as {title, message}. Sends nothing; pass the result to a notify action.

import_from_todo.name: Import from to-do lists
import_from_todo.description: Read existing to-do lists named todo.<branch>_tracker into the database (set_active false first so the names are free). Dry run by default; writes a report to /config/mission_control_backups.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Plan and verify only; write nothing to the database.

replace.name: Replace
replace.description: Overwrite branches that already hold items.

force_raw.name: Force raw
force_raw.description: Uid prefixes to store verbatim instead of normalizing.

from_file.name: From file
from_file.description: Import a Mission Control export under /config/mission_control_backups instead of the live lists.

export.name: Export
export.description: Write a JSON export of the whole database to /config/mission_control_backups (the last 30 are kept).

set_active.name: Set active
set_active.description: Start or stop serving the todo.<branch>_tracker lists from the database.

active.name: Active
active.description: True serves the lists; false removes them and frees their entity ids.
